newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu group profit to hit record in 97/98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu group profit to hit record in 97/98 - paper.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd is expected to post a record group net profit of about 90 billion yen in the 1997/98 business year thanks to robust sales of computer systems and improvements in earnings of overseas group firms, a Japanese business daily reported on Wednesday.
The company has forecast a group net profit for the current business year to March 31 of about 50 billion yen.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Fujitsu's group sales were likely to reach around five trillion yen in the next business year, up 12 percent from the 4.45 trillion yen expected this year.
It said the company's parent current profit was also expected to hit a record high of about 130 billion yen next business year, up from about 80 billion yen this year.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
